data.title: Four Seasons Private Residences
data.about:
Nestled within the Dubai International Financial Centre, Four Seasons Private Residences is a distinguished address crafted by H&H Development. Comprising 61 exclusive branded residences, this architectural landmark offers an unparalleled lifestyle experience with 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, as well as 4 and 5-bedroom penthouses. Set for handover in 2027, this refined development merges the prestige of Four Seasons with the dynamic pulse of Dubai’s financial heart.

From its elevated design by Sir David Chipperfield to its elegant interiors by Tihany Design, every element of the Four Seasons Private Residences DIFC reflects a commitment to excellence. Residents enjoy access to a comprehensive range of amenities including a terrace and outdoor swimming pool, pool bar, spa and wellness facility, private movement studio, theatre, cigar lounge, and a suite of bespoke Residence Management and À La Carte Services. .

characteristics_module.title: Discover elevated urban living at Four Seasons Private Residences DIFC
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prestigious Location in DIFC - A globally recognized financial hub with direct access to Gate Avenue and Gate Village.
  • Exclusive Branded Residences - Only 61 bespoke homes, including limited-edition penthouses with panoramic skyline views.
  • Renowned Architectural Team - Designed by Sir David Chipperfield with interiors by the acclaimed Tihany Design studio.
  • Luxurious Wellness Amenities - Spa, gym, sauna, and private movement studio for a complete wellness experience.
  • World-Class Leisure Facilities - Enjoy a golf simulator, theatre, cigar lounge, and exclusive event spaces.
  • Signature Four Seasons Services - Unmatched hospitality and management, with dedicated concierge and a la carte services.
  • Flexible Payment Plan - Convenient 60/40 payment structure with a starting price of AED 23M.
  • Anticipated Handover in 2027 - Secure your future residence in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations.

location_tile.title: Exceptional urban connectivity in the heart of DIFC
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The Four Seasons Private Residences location is set within the prestigious Dubai International Financial Centre, offering seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road (E11). Positioned on Gate Avenue, residents enjoy immediate proximity to leading financial institutions, fine dining, art galleries, and luxury retail. The location ensures both convenience and exclusivity in a vibrant and globally connected district.

  • 5 Minutes – Dubai Mall
  • 7 Minutes – Museum of the Future
  • 7 Minutes – Burj Khalifa
  • 8 Minutes – Zabeel Palace
  • 20 Minutes – Dubai Marina
